第17章 有些事情想做便做了（第1页）
“可我是慕天烨故意输给你的啊，你也不考虑一下，就要了我？”言安希说着，摇了摇头，“不对不对，是娶了我。”
“娶了你又怎样？”慕迟曜毫不在意的说着，紧接着却又声音一冷，“想反悔？”
言安希连忙否认：“没有没有，我一百个一千个愿意。”
她只是疑惑，她到底有什么地方，值得慕天烨在那么多名门千金小姐中，选择了她做未婚妻。她又有什么特别的地方，让慕迟曜二话不说就和她领证结婚。
只是他们不想让她知道的话，那她就真的永远都不会知道了。
慕迟曜看了她一眼，神色不明，冷淡又漠然。
然后他转身，在她的床上坐下，修长的双腿交叠着，半靠在床头上：“储物柜最下面有药箱，去拿过来。”
言安希应了，连忙跑去，翻出了药箱，拿了过来，放在一边，一双眼睛水灵灵的，一眨不眨看着慕迟曜：“拿来了。”
他却看也不看一眼，单手支着额角反问道：“手上不疼吗？”
言安希愣了一下，才反应过来，自己手上被李韵给烫伤了。
这么一通折腾，她都快要忘记了。被慕迟曜这么一提醒，她现在觉得烫伤的地方又有点痛了。
她找出药膏，想起了咖啡厅里的一幕，又悄悄的看了一眼眼前的男人。
“看什么？”慕迟曜问，“有什么直接说。”
言安希一边拧开药膏，一边小声问道：“我只是突然想起，为什么那么烫的咖啡倒下去，李韵她……一声都没有吭？”
言安希手里的药膏，突然就从她手里滑落，掉在柔软的地毯上。
她迅速的回过神来，连忙弯腰捡起，可是脸色却是惨白的。
这么说的话，那当时，一定是有人死死的捂住了李韵的嘴，才会让她没有发出一丁点声音来。
那么痛却又叫都叫不出来……言安希想想，都不由自主的打了个冷颤。
她的手有些发抖，但还是低着头，努力平静的往手上擦着药。
慕迟曜微微眯着眼眸，淡淡的看着坐在身边的她。
她低着头，头发从肩膀上散落下来，露出一小段白皙修长的脖颈，看上去安静而乖巧。
她在他面前，一直都收敛着，她要是把爪子都给亮出来，说不定会挠得他招架不住。
他要是再不结婚，恐怕慕城的八卦杂志、新闻，都快要造谣说他不喜欢女人了。
言安希擦着药，忽然开口打破了安静：“其实，慕迟曜，你今天在咖啡厅那样做，不是因为我受了欺负。而是你在杀鸡儆猴，警告慕天烨。我说的对不对？”
他这么爽快的承认，言安希反而愣了一下，然后笑了笑：“这是很浅显的事情。只是慕迟曜，你完全可以不必要这么麻烦的。你当初直接……不娶我就好了。”

Chapter 17 If you want to do something, just do it (Page 1)
"But I was lost to you by Mu Tianye on purpose, and you didn't even think about it before you decided to kill me?" Yan Anxi said, shaking her head, "No, no, you married me."
"So what if I marry you?" Mu Chi Yao said nonchalantly, but then his voice turned cold, "Want to regret it?"
Yan Anxi quickly denied: "No, no, I am willing a hundred, a thousand times."
She just wondered what was there about her that made Mu Tianye choose her as his fiancée among so many famous ladies. There was something special about her that made Mu Chi Yao get a marriage certificate from her without saying a word.
But if they don't want her to know, then she really will never know.
Mu Chi Yao glanced at her, his expression unclear, cold and indifferent.
Then he turned around and sat down on her bed, with his slender legs crossed and half leaning on the head of the bed: "There is a medicine box at the bottom of the locker. Go get it."
Yan Anxi agreed, ran over quickly, dug out the medicine box, took it over, and put it aside. With a pair of watery eyes, she looked at Mu Chi Yao without blinking: "Bring it here."
But he didn't even look at it. He put his forehead with one hand and asked, "Don't your hands hurt?"
Yan Anxi was stunned for a moment before she realized that her hand had been burned by Li Yun.
After all this fuss, she almost forgot. After being reminded by Mu Chi Yao, she now felt that the burnt area was a little painful again.
She found the ointment, remembered the scene in the coffee shop, and quietly glanced at the man in front of her.
"What are you looking at?" Mu Chi Yao asked, "If you have anything to say, just tell me."
Yan Anxi unscrewed the ointment and asked in a low voice: "I just suddenly remembered why Li Yun... didn't say a word when she poured such hot coffee?"
The ointment in Yan Anxi's hand suddenly slipped from her hand and fell on the soft carpet.
She quickly came to her senses and hurriedly bent down to pick it up, but her face was pale.
If you put it this way, someone must have covered Li Yun's mouth tightly at that time to prevent her from making a single sound.
It hurt so much but she couldn't even scream... Yan Anxi shuddered involuntarily when she thought about it.
Her hands were shaking a little, but she still lowered her head and tried to apply the medicine on her hands calmly.
Mu Chi Yao narrowed his eyes slightly and looked at her sitting beside him.
She lowered her head, her hair falling down from her shoulders, revealing a small section of her fair and slender neck. She looked quiet and well-behaved.
She had always been restrained in front of him. If she showed her claws, she might scratch him until he couldn't resist.
If he doesn't get married, the gossip magazines and news in Mucheng will soon spread rumors that he doesn't like women.
Yan Anxi applied the medicine and suddenly broke the silence: "Actually, Mu Chi Yao, what you did in the coffee shop today was not because I was bullied. It was because you were trying to scare the monkeys and warn Mu Tianye. Am I right?"
He admitted so readily that Yan Anxi was stunned for a moment, and then smiled: "This is a very simple matter. It's just Mu Chi Yao, you don't have to go to such trouble. It would have been better if you just... didn't marry me."
